thread:
Mira (Sales): Rapidsample needs a vendor-signed throughput proof for procurement. Target: 1k QPS sustained 20m, p50 <150ms, p99 <400ms. They also asked for FIPS KMS support and a clear cost estimate. Can eng scope a minimal run and a price band?

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Quick asks: is traffic mostly single-shot completions or chat streaming? Also what avg tokens out? Those change our batching and fleet sizing assumptions.

Mira (Sales): Customer says mostly short completions (75%) ~50 tokens out and 25% assistant-style chat (avg context 700). They require FIPS-capable key unwraps; prefer Dedicated but will consider Private if needed for egress control.

Priya (Perf Eng): For that mix we recommend a Dedicated warm pool with hybrid worker classes: short-completions workers (batch=10, concurrency=18) and streaming workers (batch=4, concurrency=6). Start with 12-14 A100-equivalent GPUs and adjust post-smoke.

Priya (Perf Eng): Run plan: 1) Prep: exchange KMS endpoint/certs; seed KV cache with representative sessions 2) Smoke: 10m @ 200 QPS 3) Ramp: Poisson 0->1k QPS over 5-6m, hold 20m, include two 30s 2x bursts 4) Tear down + collect traces.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Short CLI example for load harness we will supply; also recommend pre-warming key material in our local vault to avoid repeated HSM trips. If customer allows temporary key-proxy for the run, KMS latency risk drops dramatically.

Olga (Security): For FIPS/HSM we need vendor + endpoint + cert chain and expected unwrap QPS. Cross-region unwraps add ~70-120ms; local proxied unwraps ~20-40ms. Also note SOC2/HIPAA requires trace redaction consent and minimal retention for the run.

Mira (Sales): Pricing: need a one-off run quote and a discounted band if they accept a 1-week Dedicated reservation.

Priya (Perf Eng): Ballpark: infra-hours (GPU) + ops/SRE support + observability. Estimate 14 GPUs * ~3h ~= 42 GPU-hrs. At internal rate ~$3.25/GPU-hr => ~$140 raw infra; realistic customer-facing one-off SOW $4k-$9k depending on observability depth and HSM proxy work. With a 1-week Dedicated reservation we can credit part of the fee.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Monitoring checklist: p50/p95/p99, GPU util, host CPU, KV cache hit/evict, KMS unwrap rt, stream chunk delay, downstream tool latency, 5xx rate. Rollback triggers: p99>1s for >2m or GPU mem thrash.

infra-bot: Job created: run-1799999998-rapidsample-proof (owner: Jamal). Tentative window: 2025-05-06T16:00Z.

Mira (Sales): Good. Jamal/Priya: please drop the short runbook + 1-pager cost summary here by Tue EOD. Olga: please send KMS questionnaire link to the buyer.

Priya (Perf Eng): Will do. I'll also run a quick KMS unwrap microbenchmark today and post numbers.

Olga (Security): Will share questionnaire and note lead times: peering/cert exchange ~5 business days; Private deployment ~2-3 weeks.

Mira (Sales): Thanks team. I'll schedule customer sync after the runbook is posted. :white_check_mark:
